Done. In [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g2_add_voucher/no_okf/codex/3/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js), `addToCart` now takes an optional trailing `promoCode` parameter, and when provided it's included in the cart-item request body as `discountCode` (the field the Shopizer cart-item model defines for it) on both the add and update paths. When no code is passed, the request is byte-for-byte identical to before.

The only file I touched is `src/redux/actions/cartActions.js`. I also glanced at `src/util/constant.js` (read-only) to confirm there's no existing promo-field convention in this repo; the field name comes from the Shopizer cart-item contract itself. Note the repo is a Shopizer storefront, so `discountCode` is the matching backend field — worth a quick check against your backend if it's a fork with renamed models.
